task.title: Change sharing settings
task.shortdesc: Control what editors, commenters, and viewers can do with the shared file.

taskbody.prereq: You must be the owner of the file.

step.cmd: In , right click the file and select Share.

step.info: Setting page for the file opens.

step.cmd: Check or uncheck the options that you want to change.

choices.choice: Allow editors to change permissions and share: Lets editors change access and share the file with others.
Editors: Lets editors download, copy, print, and access the file through .
Commenters and viewers: Lets commenters and viewers download, copy, print, and access the file through .

taskbody.result: The new settings are applied to the file.
